text: I could use your help with a few repairs. We're short of metal. Could you spare ten units to keep the work moving?
We've finished a new housing block. Seeing people finally settle into their own homes makes all the hard work worthwhile.
I've drawn up plans to expand the housing district. Do I have your approval, or would you rather we focus our efforts elsewhere?
I've checked the power grid and the reserve generators. Everything is running properly. For once, I can give you some good news without asking for anything.
A few settlers have been arguing over how things are run. I'd like to hold a public meeting and hear them out. Are you happy for me to handle it?
Some traders have offered us a regular supply route. It could save us a lot of trouble. Shall I approve the agreement, or turn them down?
The patrols have checked the perimeter. Nothing unusual to report. I'm not complaining; a quiet day is a good day around here.
Would you approve a covered garden for the settlement? A little greenery and somewhere peaceful to sit could do everyone some good.
Our survey team found some abandoned equipment nearby. It might still be useful. Can you help me decide: send a salvage crew, or leave it alone?
Nothing urgent today. The settlement is finding its feet, and people keep asking when you'll visit again. You're still welcome here, even when there's nothing that needs fixing.
